first: Hope the cleaning goes smoothly! Get some rest.

turns.user:
I'm good, let's keep going. Nice — I finished the helper columns. Can you give me an Apps Script that:

- Finds duplicate groups (same email OR same name within 10 minutes),
- Picks the best row to keep by highest count of non-empty cleaned fields (JoinedBefore, Phone, PreferredPark, Email),
- Marks the others as SUPERSEDED and copies the chosen row’s cleaned values into a new CleanedRow set of columns,
- Creates a "Conflicts" column listing which fields differed between rows in the group so I can manually confirm those (e.g., "Phone, PreferredPark"),
- Optionally fills missing 7-digit phones with a default area code I’ll put in a cell (e.g., Sheet!Z1) before counting completeness.

Paste the script I can drop into Extensions > Apps Script; keep it readable and with minimal comments.

Nice — that script looks close. Two tweaks please:

1) Make the winner selection sort by completeness score, then by most recent timestamp (newer wins on ties).  
2) When copying the winner’s cleaned values into SUPERSEDED rows, only copy fields that are non-empty on the winner (don’t overwrite a non-empty target with a blank winner field).

Also: have it operate on the sheet named "Responses" (not necessarily the active sheet) and keep the same output columns starting at Q. Can you update the script with those changes? Keep it compact with just minimal comments.

Ran it and hit a syntax error — the final alert line has bad quotes around "Responses". Can you fix that and also tweak the script so it doesn't overwrite the header row if headers already exist in Q1:V1 (i.e., only write headers if those cells are blank)? Paste the corrected compact script.

Ran it — mostly good. Two small tweaks please:

1) When copying winner values into SUPERSEDED rows, also copy Email (same rules: only copy if winner has a usable email and target email is empty).  
2) Exclude rows whose Review flag (column P) equals "REVIEW" from being chosen as the group's winner — they should still be in the group, marked SUPERSEDED, and show conflicts, but winners must have P <> "REVIEW".

Paste the updated compact script with those changes.

Nice — that mostly fixed it. Two small tweaks before I run again:

1) Don't add a CleanedEmail column. Keep the output exactly 6 columns starting at Q: CleanedJoined, CleanedPhone, CleanedTimestamp, CleanedPark, Superseded (U), Conflicts (V). Still have the script copy the winner's Email into SUPERSEDED rows (but not as a separate output column).

2) Change the header check so it writes headers only if all cells in Q1:V1 are blank OR if any of them are blank (so it won't overwrite a custom header if any header cell is non-blank). In short: only write headers when the entire Q1:V1 is blank; otherwise leave existing headers alone (current script writes only if all blank — but it still replaced headers when some were blank; make it stricter: require all blank).

Can you paste the updated compact script with those two changes?

turns.text:
Glad it's all working! You've got a solid cleaning pipeline now — formula-based helpers in G–P catching the normalization and flagging issues, and the script handling deduplication, winner selection, and conflict surfacing in one pass.

If you come back to this later, the most likely things to revisit are adding new park variants to `ParkMap` as your data grows, and adjusting the 10-minute window if you find legitimate same-name submissions getting grouped incorrectly. Good luck with the volunteer data!
